npm.jose: JWT signature verification of access tokens against the IdP's JWKS (E05-R01); never opens event envelopes.

platform.php: PHP language runtime; no event-content crypto library.
platform.ext-openssl: PHP transport TLS support only; must not be used to open event envelopes.
platform.ext-hash: Hashes for integrity checks and delegated-principal authentication; not event-content decryption.
platform.ext-dom: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-filter: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-iconv: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-json: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-libxml: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-mbstring: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-pdo: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-pdo_pgsql: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-phar: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-tokenizer: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-xmlwriter: Standard PHP parsing, encoding, database or archive/runtime facility; not event-content cryptography.
platform.ext-ctype: SabreDAV character classification; not content crypto.
platform.ext-curl: sabre/http HTTP transport; no envelope decryption.
platform.ext-date: SabreDAV calendar timestamps and vobject recurrence; no content crypto.
platform.ext-pcre: SabreDAV protocol validation with regular expressions.
platform.ext-spl: PHP collections and iterators used by SabreDAV.
